title: A Ranked Removal 🏆
excerpt: Introducing Removal Ranks, rank-up animations, expanded badge support, improved Unfriend History, FR+ updates, and more!
body: FR UPDATE 2.5 introduces Removal Ranks, bringing new rank-up animations, special name colors, and rank badges to your Friends List. We've also improved Unfriend History, expanded Roblox badge support, introduced new FR+ improvements, and delivered numerous fixes and performance enhancements.

added.moreInfo: Added a dedicated screen where users can view their Removal Rank.
Users now receive a notification with a new animation when their Removal Rank increases.
Users can now view their Removal Rank directly from the menu.
Special Removal Rank name colors now appear in the Friends List.
Added support for displaying FR+, Removal Rank, Roblox Verified, Roblox Premium, Roblox Plus, and Roblox Admin badges in the Friends List.
The Halloween theme can now be used while Light Mode is enabled.
Brought Bulk Dismiss back to Unfriend History.
Unfriend History cards now display the method used to remove each friend.
FR+ users can now use swear words in their notes and have an increased character limit of 100, up from 50.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the Receive Notifications setting from mobile Settings.
Removed the Privacy First — One-Time Use option from Settings.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue preventing Removal Mode settings from saving correctly.
Fixed the Single Dismiss option not working.
Fixed an issue preventing friends in Mutual Mode from displaying their checkmarks.
Fixed Mutual Mode failing to apply scheduled friend protection.
Fixed an issue preventing users from pinning banned users.
Fixed an issue causing the FR+ notification to appear incorrectly.
Fixed Settings incorrectly displaying FR+ as 115 per month instead of a one-time payment.

improved.moreInfo: Mutual Mode now loads only friends who share mutual connections with you.
Security Lock is no longer in beta.
Imported Unfriend History is now stored locally.
Imported history no longer contributes toward Removal Rank progression.
Enforced the 1,000-entry Unfriend History limit and fixed an issue that allowed users to import more data than the limit.
Manual friend removal is now blocked when Unfriend History is full. Users must clear their history before removing more friends.
The FR+ rank is now displayed in the Friends List even when obtained through a group rank.
Reduced lag when switching between Removal Modes.
Changed the Unfriend History toast notification to purple.
Reduced the number of Roblox Status API calls to improve efficiency.
Improved Roblox badge loading in the Friends List.
Reduced the size of the new Friends List badges.
The Removal Rank badge now appears before the FR+ badge.
Improved badge spacing and presentation for a cleaner, easier-to-read Friends List.
